sites.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
sites.about: Where Perseverance touched down. The rover drove all around it.

sites.name: Unvisited site A: north, middle ground
sites.about: No rover track within 421 m. Flat, firm ground: 3.8 deg slope. Only seen from orbit.

sites.name: Unvisited site B: west, high ground
sites.about: No rover track within 299 m. Flat, firm ground: 2.9 deg slope. Only seen from orbit.

sites.name: Unvisited site C: north-west, high ground
sites.about: No rover track within 326 m. Flat, firm ground: 3.1 deg slope. Only seen from orbit.

source: NASA Mars 2020 traverse (visited or not) + HiRISE terrain model (site screening) + HiRISE mosaic via Mars Trek (close-ups)
